name: Love Without Courage
source:
Sometimes you miss someone who isn't yours to miss. Sometimes you dream about someone who isn't yours to dream about. Sometimes, you love someone who isn't yours to love. 

Love without courage is a very tiny kinetic novel about two people hopelessly in love who find it an arduous task to open their hearts to each other, both of them having fears of their own. Read the visual novel, to see how this messes up their love life and the potential of any romantic development in future.
translation:
有时候，你会想念一个不属于你的人。有时你会梦见一个不属于你的人。有时候，你爱一个不属于你的人。

《没有勇气的爱》是一部非常微小的动态小说，讲述了两个绝望地相爱的人发现向对方敞开心扉是一项艰巨的任务，而且他们都对自己有恐惧。阅读视觉小说，看看这如何扰乱他们的爱情生活以及未来浪漫发展的潜力。
